card.name: Digits inside numbers in science text
card.fires_on: A single digit token inside or at the start of a multi-digit number, mostly in science and astronomy text. The number is usually a measurement such as miles, degrees, gigapixels, kilometers or meters.

modes.label: Digit inside a measurement
modes.description: A digit begins or sits within a quantity with a unit like miles, meters or degrees.
modes.example: Rising to a height of 8<<8>>48m, the world’s highest

modes.label: Digit in a year or long decimal
modes.description: A digit within a year or a long decimal number.

modes.label: Leading digit of a count or value
modes.description: The first digit of a quantity, often followed by more digits.
modes.example: So what could you do with <<5>>0 gigapixels?

card.plain: It lights up on single digits within numbers in science writing, such as distances, temperatures and years.
